name: Montserrat
summary: A British blue ensign with Montserrat's coat of arms: Erin, the personification of Ireland, in green, holding a gold harp and embracing a black Latin cross. It reflects the island's Irish heritage.
origin: Montserrat was settled in the 17th century largely by Irish Catholics from Saint Kitts and Virginia. The coat of arms was granted in 1909 and the flag adopted in 1960; the arms were enlarged in 1999.

symbols.name: Erin
symbols.description: A woman in green holding a harp and a cross.
symbols.meaning: Ireland and the Irish origins of the settlers.

facts: Montserrat is nicknamed 'the Emerald Isle of the Caribbean'.
Saint Patrick's Day is a public holiday in Montserrat.
The Soufrière Hills volcano destroyed the capital, Plymouth, in 1997.
